GitHub marks this release Latest for update discovery. **It remains experimental
and is not proven production-ready.** Limited checks were performed on one Mac;
mobile devices, concurrent edits, migration and rollback require further testing.
Back up the vault and device sync state before upgrading. Upgrade and verify one
device at a time. A connected status does not prove all devices have every change.

The release contains `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css`. It does not
include sync credentials or per-device configuration. See the repository README
for current limitations.
